tei:div.tei:p: (1na)rje dwags po rin po che'i tshogs chos chen po bzhugs//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru/ chos 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bka' bzhi'i brgyud pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun tai lo pa/ nā ro mai tri thar lam dang*/ rje mar pa dang*/ rje btsun mi la ras pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu zhes bya ba mchog gi dngos grub thob pa des/ sa steng kun tu grub thob kyi sa bon thebs pa yang chos 'di 'ba' zhig gis mdzad pa yin/ de la rje dus gsum mkhyen pas zhus/ de la 'gro mgon ras pa chen po dang*/ slob dpon rin po che spom brag pa dang*/ rin po che karma pa yan chad dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing*/ smin grol gyi rgyal mtshan ma 'gyel ba/ byin rlabs kyi zar kha ma log cing*/ byang chub kyi myu gu ma skam pas/ 'gro don phyogs med du mdzad cing bka' brgyud kyi rgyal sa zin pa yin gsung*/ byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu la bcom ldan 'das kyis 'gro ba'i don du dbang bskur zhing*/ lung bstan pa ni kha ba can du (2na)sku 'khrungs shing*/ bla ma chen po nā ro pa dang*/ dpal a ti sha gnyis kyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa nges par thugs su chud pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rat+na gu ru puṇ+ya rat+na zhes bya bas chos du ma khrigs su gsungs pa rnams/ dpal shes rab gzhon nus yi ger bkod pa lags/ bla ma rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ spyir chos byed pa la gzhi dad pa/ lam brtson 'grus/ grogs shes rab yin pas/ dad pa dang shes rab brtson 'grus dang ldan dgos pas/ de yang rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dad can yin phyir chos la brtson// shes rab ldan phyir yang dag rig /de gnyis gtso bo shes rab te// de yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste// sa bon me yis tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no// de yang dngos gzhi dad pa la chos bdun/

dad pa skye ba'i rgyu/ dad pa skyes pa'i tshad/ dad (2ba)pa'i dbye ba/ dad pa'i ngo bo/ dad pa dang mthun pa'i dpe/ dad pa'i byed las/ dad pa brtan pa'i tshad dang bdun/ de la dang po dad pa skye ba'i rgyu bzhi/ mdo sde la bltas na dad pa skye/ de yang dang po mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ de nas lta gsung*/ grogs dad pa can dang 'grogs na dad pa skye bas/ de yang rams dang 'grogs na sngo/ btsag dang 'grogs na dmar bas/ grogs dad pa can gal che/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten na dad pa skye/ de yang yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ chos gang dang yang ma 'gal bar nyams su len shes pa ste/ de lta bu zhig dang 'grogs na dad pa skye/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom na dad pa skye/ de yang nam 'chi cha med/ tshe la long med/ myur du 'chi/ myur du mi rtag par go /nges par yid ches pas dad pa skye gsung*/ gnyis pa dad pa skyes pa'i tshad ni/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa go bas 'jig rten 'di'i mngon zhen la blo ldog /las rgyu 'bras la nges par yid ches pas/ dge sdig la 'dzem pa dang*/ bsags sbyang la brtson/ bya rgyu chos las med/ bsam rgyu chos las med pa zhig 'ong gsung*/ gsum pa dad pa'i dbye ba la gsum/ dang ba'i dad pa dang*/ yid ches pa'i dad pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i dad pa'o// dang po dang ba'i dad pa ni/ bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zhal mthong ba dang*/ gsung thos pa dang*/ rten khyad par can gyi drung du phyin pa'i dus su ba spu ldang ba dang*/ mchi ma 'khrug pa tsam du dad pa 'ong*/ gnyis pa yid ches pa'i dad pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' rgyas bsdus gang la yang the tshom mi za bar nyams su len pa'o// gsum pa 'dod pa'i dad pa ni nyams su blangs pa'i (3na)chos che chung gang la yang*/ de'i 'bras bu des sgrib pa myur du byang bar 'dod pa dang*/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba dang*/ yon tan nges par thob par 'dod pa'o// bzhi pa dad pa'i ngo bo ni dad pa dang*/

ma dad pa ma 'dres pa/ dad pa kha zhu 'og 'khyags su ma song ba dang*/ dad pa phye kha thal zhabs su ma song ba zhig dgos te/ dkar po'i chos 'ba' zhig byed pa'o// lnga pa dad pa mthun pa'i dpe ni/ nor bu chu dwangs dang 'dra ste/ nor bu chu dwangs/ chu rnyog ma can gyi nang du bcug pas dwangs par byed pa ltar/ dad pas rgyud dwangs snyigs 'byed pa yin/ drug pa dad pa'i byed las ni/ las mi dge ba rnams zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du 'grib par byed/ dge ba rnams zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin 'phel bar byed pa'o// bdun pa dad pa brtan pa'i tshad ni/ 'dun dang zhe sdang 'jigs pa dang*// rmongs pas yang dag chos mi 'da'// de la dad pa can zhes bya// zhes gsungs pas so// 'dun pas chos las mi 'da'/ zhe sdang gis chos las mi 'da'/ 'jigs pas chos las mi 'da'/ rmongs pas chos las mi 'da' ba zhig ni dgos te/ chos de rnams dang ldan na dad pa yin gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rgya gar na dge tshul cig gis/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi ba la maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis khyod ci 'dod gsungs skad/ nga gdams ngag zhu ba yin byas pas/ slob dpon gyis khyod nga dang 'brel ba med pas song la nga'i slob ma a ti sha la gdams pa zhus shig dang*/ khyod dang de las 'brel yod par 'dug gsung*/ dge tshul des jo bo rje la gsol ba btab pas/ jo bos khyod ci 'dod gsung*/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi (3ba)bas nga lung bstan pa yin/ gdams pa zhu byas pas jo bos spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs cig bstan nas khos nyams su blangs pas mthong ba'i mtshan ma dang*/ reg pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ sgra'i mtshan ma byung nas/ spyan ras gzigs la chos ci zhu zhur yod pa la/ jo bos 'drir bcug pa la/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang yin/ gegs gang gis byed/ nan tan gang la bya/ lta ba rnams kyi nang nas gang gal che/ rnam par shes pa tshogs du yod/ tshogs gang gis rdzogs zhes 'drir bcug pa la/

spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin/ gegs rnam par smin pa phra ba'i phra bas kyang byed/ nan tan las rgyu 'bras la bya/ lta ba rnams kyi nang nas yang dag pa'i lta ba gal che/ rnam par shes pa la tshogs drug tu yang gsungs brgyad du yang gsungs te/ bsdu na rnam par shes pa'i tshogs gcig la bya/ dper na spre'u mkhar snang du bcug pa lta bu yin/ tshogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rdzogs so gsung ngo*// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ dkar po'i chos spyod thos bsam nyan bshad srung sdom bsags sbyang sgom sgrub la sogs ci byed kyang chos las su ma song bar/ chos chos su 'gro ba zhig dgos gsung*/ 'o na las gang yin zhe na/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes gsungs pas/ dngos su bskyed na lha mi'i bde ba la sogs pa yin te/ dkar po'i dge ba yang tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ chos brgyad kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i chos spyod ci byas kyang las su song ba yin pas/ de ltar ma song bar byed pa la/ rin po che'i zhal nas chos bzhi yin (4na)gsung*/ de la chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba'o// de yang chos chos su 'gro ba la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i chos su 'gro ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos su 'gro ba'o// de la 'jig rten pa'i chos su 'gro ba ni/ de yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa go ba/ las 'bras go nas yid ches pas/ skye ba phyi ma ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs skrag nas/ dkar po'i dge ba ci byed pa thams cad 'jig rten phyi ma ngan song gi sgo khegs par 'dod/ mtho ris lha lus mi lus rnam par dag pa dang*/ lha yi bde ba dang*/ mi'i bde ba dang*/ lha'i longs spyod nges par thob par 'dod pa'i ched du byed pa thams cad rang nyid gcig po zhi bde 'jig rten pa'i chos su 'gro ba yin/

mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos su 'gro ba bya ba ni/ 'khor ba mtha' dag gis nyes dmigs go nas/ lha lus mi lus lha dang mi'i longs spyod gang la yang ma zhen ma chags nas skyug log /yi mug 'byung*/ 'khor ba me dong lta bur go /brtson ra brtson dong*/ mun pa mun rum/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab lta bur go /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por go /nges par yid ches pas 'khor ba'i bde ba dang*/ yon tan gang la yang ma chags ma zhen pas bdag 'khor ba las myur du thar bar 'dod/ grol bar 'dod nas chos kyi byed pa thams cad rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde mya ngan las 'das pa'i nyan thos kyi byang chub dang theg pa dman pa'i nyes dmigs go bas/ dkar po'i bsags sbyang byed pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos su 'gro ba yin/ de ltar chos chos su 'gro ba yin gsung*/ chos lam du 'gro ba la (4ba)gnyis/ lam gyi gzhir 'gro ba dang*/ lam dngos su 'gro ba'o// lam gyi gzhir 'gro ba ni theg pa dman pa'i nyes dmigs go bas/ dkar po'i bsags sbyang gi rim pa che 'bring ci byed pa thams cad byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas nges par thob par 'dod pa'i ched du byed pa ni lam gyi gzhi yin/ lam dngos su 'gro ba ni/ kun rdzob tu rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu rjes su dran/ chos spyod che 'bring ci byed pa thams cad byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu/ thabs shes rab ya ma bral bar nyams su len pa yin te/ de ltar gnyis kyis chos lam du 'gro'o// lam 'khrul pa sel ba la gnyis/ yod med dang rtag chad du 'dzin pa de 'khrul pa yin/ de rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur nyams su blangs pas sel/ theg pa dman pas rang don du byas pa de 'khrul pa yin/

de la byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas sel te/ de lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba yin no// 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba la gnyis/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs so// pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni/ 'khrul pa sel mkhan gyi shes pa de kun rdzob sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i tshul gyis gzung 'dzin thams cad gdod ma nas tha mi dad cing*/ gnyis su med pa rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa/ mi snang ba/ snang ba med pa/ gzung 'dzin nye bar zhi ba (5na)spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs tsa na/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba yin no// gsang sngags kyi lugs kyis 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni/ 'khrul pa dang ma 'khrul pa thams cad rang gi sems gnyis su med cing*/ tha mi dad pas sems kyi rang bzhin/ sems kyi ngo bo/ sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ 'khrul mkhan rang la gsal la rtog pa med pa/ gsal stong ngos bzung med pa/ gsal stong rgyun chad med pa/ gsal stong mtha' dbus med pa/ rig pa rten med pa gcer bu/ sings kyis don gzhi thog tu rtogs dgos/ de lta bu'i sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i ngo bo dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i 'od/ phyi gzung bar bya ba'i yul/ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad sems nyid dang tha mi dad pa/ gnyis su med pa/ mnyam pa nyid/ spros bral bde ba chen por 'char dgos te/ 'ub hril gyis bsdus na 'khrul pa ma rig pa yin/ rig pa ye shes su shar nas 'khrul pa ye shes su shar ba yin gsung*/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i gdams ngag lhan cig skyes sbyor ni/ go cha gnyis kyis lam du 'khyer bar bya ste/ phyi lta ba'i go cha dang*/ nang shes rab kyi go cha'o// de yang sdig pa mi dge ba srog gi phyir yang mi byed cing*/ dkar po dge ba rgyun mi gcod pa phyi lta ba'i go cha'o// nang shes rab kyi go cha la gnyis/

phyi lus kyi na tsha mi spong ba dang*/ nang sems kyi rnam rtog mi spong ba'o// phyi yul gyi na tsha mi spong ba la/ nad sma dbab pa dang*/ nad rtsad bcad pa dang*/ nad lam du 'khyer ba'o// nad sma dbab pa ni/ nad chung bar mi bsam par sngar bas kyang che bar bsams te/ des (5ba)bde ba'o// rtsad bcad pa ni nad dang po gang nas 'ongs/ bar du gar gnas/ tha ma gar 'gro ba bsams pas dang po 'ongs sa med par thar gnas sa 'gro sa med par rtogs pas rtog pa zhi nas 'ong*/ nad lam khyer ni bde sdug thams cad gnyis med du shes dgos te/ na ba yang sems nad du 'dzin pa yang sems yin te/ nad 'di la brten nas don ci 'grub bya snyam pa'o// nang sems kyi rnam rtog mi spong ba la/ rnam rtog sku drin can du lta/ med du mi rung bar lta/ dgos par lta/ snying du sdug par lta/ de ltar rnam rtog ngo bo nyid kyi rnam rtog yin/ rnam rtog grogs yin/ rnam rtog lam yin/ rnam rtog shes rab kyi bud shing yin pas/ de yang dang po dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi sgrub/ bar du mi gnas/ tha mar mi 'dzin/ dang po dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi sgrub pa ni/ blo ngor ci byung ba thams cad rnam rtog tu gcod/ rnam rtog sems su gcod/ sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur gcod pa'o// de yang las dang po pa rnams kyis ni bzang rtog gis ngan rtog sel dgos te/ dper na nyi ma sgrib par byed pa la/ sprin dkar pos bsgribs pa dang nag pos bsgrib pa 'dra ste/ skyes bu 'ching bar byed na lcags sgrog gis bcings pa dang gser sgrog gis bcings pa 'dra bas dpe de bzhin du bzang rtog gis bcings pa dang*/ ngan rtog gis bcings pa 'dra ste/ bzang rtog ngan rtog thams cad sems su gcod/ sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur gcod pa'o// de ni gcod pa'i stong nyid yin/ bar du mi gnas pa ni/ de ltar bzang rtog thams cad bcad pas/

shes pa thang chad nas zhi na yang de la gnas su mi 'jug /mi rtog na yang de la (6na)gnas su mi 'jug /stong pa nyid du 'dzin yang de la gnas su mi 'jug /de thams cad rnam rtog tu gcod/ rnam rtog ye shes su gcod/ sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur gcod pa'o// tha mar mi 'dzin pa ni/ de ltar bcad pa de bzhin du yang mi 'dzin/ lam du yang mi 'dzin/ 'bras bur yang mi 'dzin/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gang du yang mi 'dzin pa'o// phrad pa yi blo stong nyid ni/ phrad 'joms phyi snyegs me sprul lo// phrad 'joms kyi dpe ni/ mi sngar 'dris pa lta bu ste/ rnam rtog byung ma thag tu chos skur ngo shes pa'o// phyis snyegs pa'i dpe ni/ sngar ma 'dris pa lta bu ste/ mtsho la kha ba bab pa lta bu'o// kha ba bab ma thag tu mi zhu bar rjes la zhu ba ltar/ rnam rtog ngo ma shes kyang sngar btsal rjes la bsams pas shes pa'o// me sbrul pa'i dpe ni nags la me mched pa lta bu ste/ me chung ba'i dus su rlung la sogs pas gsod pa'i rkyen byed/ me cher song nas rlung ji ltar che bas grogs su 'gro ba ltar/ rang la skur pa drag po phog pa'am/ mdze byung ba'am/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen shin tu drag po 'byung ba na bsgom mo// de rnam rtog tu bcad/ rnam rtog sems su bcad/ sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur bcad cing bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas gsos 'debs nus pa dang*/ 'gal ba sgyur nus pa dang*/ ma 'khrul pa dang*/ shes rab kyis chos sgo phyed pa yin te/ gsos 'debs nus pa ni/ 'di ltar rnam rtog gcig chos skur shes na/ kun shes pas dper na phyogs gcig gi chu 'thungs na rgya mtsho ma lus pa shes par 'gyur/ 'dam bu gcig khog stong na kun khong stong*/ tshar bu gcig rkang rub na kun (6ba)rub pa lta bu'o// 'gal ba sgyur nus pa ni/ gong ltar me sbrul la blo sbyangs pas/ dngos su rkyen ngan ci byung yang thams cad grogs su 'char ba yin/

ma 'khrul ba ni/ sngar rnam rtog ngo ma shes pas 'khrul pa yin te/ rnam rtog gi rtsa ba chod rnam rtog chos skur ngo shes pas 'khrul rgyu med pa'o// shes rab kyis sgo phyed pa ni/ dper na mdung nam mkha' la skor ba dang 'dra ste/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsung ngo*// bla ma rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis dang po phyi gzung ba'i yul rtsad gcod de/ dper na gtsubs shing dang gtsubs stan dang skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba las me byung ste/ des nags thams cad tshig nas thal ba yang med pa ltar/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rig pas gzhal gzhig btang*/ gtan la phab nas/ phyi gzung ba'i yul rtsad chod na/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems sgrog rang brdal la 'gro gsung ngo*// phyag rgya chen po pa'i lugs kyis nang 'dzin pa'i sems rtsad chod na/ phyi gzung ba'i yul sgrog rang brdal du 'gro gsung*/ 'dzin pa'i sems rtsad gcod pa la/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ mtshan nyid ngo bo rang bzhin gsum yin gsung*/ sems kyi mtshan nyid la gnyis/ phyi yul snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba dang*/ nang rnam rtog dge mi dge sna tshogs su 'phro ba'o// de yang ngo bo dang mtshan nyid gnyis/ sems dang sems las byung ba yin te/ dper na nam mkha' la sprin mthug pa dang*/ srab pa dang dkar dmar sna tshogs 'byung ste/ byung yang nam mkha' las byung*/ thim yang nam mkha' la thim pa ltar/ rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs (7na)su 'phro ba dang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa dbang po'i yul sna tshogs su snang yang sems las byung ba yin/ de ltar du snang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid yin/ sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya ba ni rang gi rig pa nga'o snyam bdag go snyam pa sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong ngos bzung med pa rgyun chad med pa rig pa rten med pa gcer bu rjen par lam gyis rtogs pa'o// 'o na sems kyi ngo bo ci lta bu yin zhe na/

yod pa yang ma yin med pa yang ma yin/ rtag pa yang ma yin chad pa yang ma yin/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma yang ma yin te/ bcad pas mi chod pa/ bshig pas mi shigs pa/ bsgyur bas mi 'gyur ba/ bkag pas mi khegs pa zhig yin/ dus thams cad du 'gro 'ong med pa/ dus gsum rgyun chad med pa yin pas bcad pas mi chod/ 'dus byas ma yin te/ gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yin pas/ bshig pas mi shigs/ gzugs dang kha dog tu ma grub/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pa yin pas kyang bkag pas mi khegs so// de lta bu'i don rtogs na sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya/ bde ba chen po zhes bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ gnyis su med pa zhes bya ste/ de lta bu'i ngo bo dang rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phro ba gnyis med du chod dgos/ de ltar ngo bo dang mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis tha dad med par shes pa la/ rang bzhin zhes bya ste/ de lta bu'i don rtogs na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yin/ de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la gnas te/ mdo las kyang*/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang (7ba)med// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed nas// 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad sangs rgyas rgyu// zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i don rtogs par bya ba la/ mos gus dang brtson 'grus kyis ma yengs par nyams su blang ba'o// de yang mtshan bcas bsgom dus mtshan med mi bsgom/ mtshan med bsgom dus mtshan bcas yid la mi bya'o// sems kyi glang po dmigs pa'i ka ba la dran 'dun gyi zhags pas btags nas/ bag yod par spyod cig ces gsungs pas/ gang nyams su len pa de la ma yengs par bya ba'o// gang nyams su blangs pa'i dus su bla mas gdams ngag thad so dang sbyar nas btab pa de ma lags pa/ blo yar mar song na rnam pa thams cad du sgom mi yong ste/

bdud du shes par bya gsung*/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ skyes bu tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa gal che/ phyag rgya chen po ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la zer ba yin/ de gar tshol zhe na rang gi sems la tshol ba yin/ de yang phyag ces pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// mar la mar ni bzhag pa bzhin// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// zhes gsungs pa de yin/ rgya la rnam pa gsum ste/ rang bzhin gyi rgya/ nyams myong gi rgya/ rtogs pa'i rgya dang gsum mo// rang bzhin gyi rgya ni/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab// ces pa ste/ sems kyi gnas lugs te/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad/ 'jag mig gi srin 'bu tshun tshad la (8na)ma khyab pa med pas/ he badz+ra las/ bshang lam srin 'bu la sogs pa// ngo bo nyid kyi bdag nyid can// zhes gsungs/ 'o na rang bzhin de yod pas chog gam zer na mi chog ste/ bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyis nyams su myong dgos te/ nyams su ci ltar myong na/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal skye 'gag med pa'i don mngon sum tshad mas nyams su myong dgos/ des na sems kyi mtshan nyid ni rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang*/ yul dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba dang tha dad med pa/ sems kyi ngo bo sems kyi cho 'phrul yin te/ hril gyis dril na sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od dang*/ snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus pa thams cad rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa/ rnam par byang ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis dben pa/ smra bsam brjod las 'das pa shar ba ni nyams myong gi rgya yin no// rtogs pa'i rgya ni/ de lta bu'i don yang*/

rgyu dang rkyen gyis mi bskyed/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub/ gzugs dang kha dog tu ma grub/ yod med la sogs pa'i sgro skur mtha' dag dang bral ba/ 'dus ma byas pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa/ yang rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyi skur grub par rtogs pas rtogs pa'i rgya'o// de bas na bla na med pa dang gong na med pa'i phyir na chen po'o// de lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i gdams ngag de la/ rjes kyi ye shes bzhi 'char dgos te/ sems can la snying rje che dgos/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad gus cher 'gro dgos/ las rgyu 'bras la shin tu 'dzem du 'gro dgos/ tshe 'di'i mngon par zhen (8ba)pa thams cad 'jig dgos gsung*/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa rjes su dran/ las rgyu 'bras rjes su dran/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rjes su dran/ theg pa dman pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa la thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin/ de bas na/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs// rim gnyis mnyam par bzhag nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// zhes so// de'i don bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la chos drug yin/ bskyed rim gyi dbye ba/ ngo bo// nges tshig /dgos pa/ brtan pa'i tshad/ 'bras bu dang drug yin/ dang po dbye ba ni/ sgrub thabs rim gyis bskyed pa dang*/ cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa dang*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis bskyed pa dang gsum yin no// gnyis pa ngo bo tha mal gyi rnam rtog bzlog nas/ ngo bo lhar gsal ba'o// gsum pa nges tshig sems lus lhar bskyed pa dang*/ lus sems lhar gsal ba dang*/

sems tshig tu brjod pa lhar bskyed pa gsum yin/ de la lus sems lhar bskyed pa ni/ tha mal gyi sha khrag gdos pa can 'di mi dmigs pa las/ lha'i skur gsal ba yin/ sems lus lhar bskyed pa ni/ lha'i sku de yang sems kyi snang ba sgyu ma'am/ 'ja' tshon lta bur shes pa yin/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu de yang*/ ming tsam/ brda' tsam/ btags pa tsam/ tha (9na)snyad tsam du rang bzhin gzhi bral du shes pa yin/ bzhi pa dgos pa la spyir dgos pa dang*/ bye brag tu dgos pa gnyis/ de la spyir dgos pa ni/ rab zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsgrub/ 'bring dang tha mas tha mal gyi zhen pa bzlog /bye brag tu dgos pa la/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa la dgos pa gsum yod de/ tha mal gyi 'khrul pa zhig pa'i dgos pa yod/ rang dang lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad du shes pa'i dgos pa yod/ rang gi rig 'dzin gyi dam tshig bsrung bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do// ye shes sems dpa' la dgos pa gsum yod de/ rang dang lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad du shes pa'i dgos pa yod/ tha mi dad du shes pa la lhas byin gyis rlob pa'i dgos pa yod/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa la dgos pa gsum/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa srung ba'i 'khor lo mchog tu 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ dbang bskur la dgos pa gsum/ rgyu'i chos pha rol tu phyin pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dgos pa yod/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ de ltar bcu gnyis bye brag tu dgos pa'o// brtan pa'i tshad la rang gi cha nas bzhag pa gsum/

gzhan gyi cha nas bzhag pa gsum/ rang gi cha nas bzhag pa ni/ 'gro nyal 'dug gsum du rang lhar gsal na brtan pa tha ma/ (9ba)phyi snod gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal na brtan pa 'bring*/ de ltar gsal ba'i thog tu/ lha thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma chu zla lta bu'i lhar gsal ba na brtan pa rab/ gzhan gyi cha nas gzhag pa rnam pa gsum ni/ rang grol gzhan gyis lhar mthong na brtan pa rab/ rang la dus thams cad du lhar gsal na brtan pa 'bring*/ yi dwags la lhar gsal na brtan pa tha ma'o// 'bras bu la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis/ mthar thug gi gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'byung*/ gnas skabs la rab tshe 'di la brten nas bden pa mthong*/ 'bring skye ba phyi ma la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ tha ma lha mi'i lus rnam par dag pa thob/ des 'bras bu dang*/ de ltar drug gis bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan nas/ chos de rnams dang ldan pa yin gsung ngo*/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni// sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol// gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas// rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pas/ de yang dus zhes pa ni dal 'byor mi lus thob/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ chos rin po che thos/ yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che dang mjal/ gdams ngag nyams su len pa'i dus 'dir 'bad dgos pa yin gsung*/ de yang*/ dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan byas te// byang chub tu yang blo brtan bya// zhes pas dang po thun mong gi lam rnams rgyud la skye bas/ gzhi dad pa brtan pa gal che/ de nas byang chub la blo brtan par byed pa la/ chos thams cad kyi snying po yin pas rang gi sems ngo shes dgos/ de shes par byed pa la/ phyi gzung (10na)ba'i yul dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems gnyis yin/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems la sems dang sems gzung bar bya ba'i yul byung ba ste/

ngo bo dang mtshan nyid gnyis yin gsung*/ phyi gzung ba'i yul ni rang gi lus kyang phar bcad pa thams cad yin/ de ltar nang 'dzin pa'i sems dang por ngo shes dgos/ bar du 'dris dgos/ tha mar klong du gyur dgos/ dang por ngo shes pa la gsum/ sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gsal stong ngos bzung med pa nyams su myong ba'i tshad mas ngo shes dgos/ rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phro ba gnyis med du ngo shes dgos/ de nas phyi dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba'i yul dang gsum khyad med du shes dgos/ bar du 'dris par bya ba la/ gnas dur khrod dam dben pa'i gnas su brtson 'grus dang ldan pas tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs na/ 'char lugs rnam pa gsum gang rung du 'ong ste/ mnyam rjes tha dad pa dang*/ mnyam rjes dus mtshungs pa dang*/ mnyam rjes gnyis med du 'char ba'o// de yang mnyam rjes tha dad pa ni/ sgom pa'i dus su yod la/ rjes la med pa'o// 'di'i dus su nang du rnam rtog gis tshur la gnod pa med la phar gnod mi nus pa yin pas/ rang nyid gnas dben par bsdad la/ bla ma la gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs/ mos gus rgyun chad med par byas nas rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa gal che gsung ngo*// mnyam rjes dus mtshungs pa ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su yod la/ rjes la yang spyod lam rnam bzhis mi gnod/ nang rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phro ba yang sems nyid dang gnyis med du thag chod/ (10ba)phyi'i snang ba dkar dmar yang*/ res sgyu ma/ res stong pa/ res dngos po'am/ mtha' dbus su 'char te/ 'di'i dus su sgom chen tshan cig gis nga 'dug pa las 'gro ba nyams myong bzang zer te/ gnas dben par rang nyid gcig por 'dug pa gal che gsung ngo*// mnyam rjes gnyis med du 'char ba ni/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i 'od/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/

gzung bar bya ba'i yul snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid spros bral bde ba chen por rtogs/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang ma bzhag pa khyad med/ spyod lam rnam bzhi ci byed pa thams cad mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos par dus thams cad du chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'gro /dran 'dun dang rtog dpyod btang mi dgos par phril gyis 'gro ba yin/ de'i dus su 'gro ba dang 'dug pa la khyad med/ sgom chen pa'i bya ba yin pas 'gro ba bas 'dug pa btsun/ lar yang sgom chen pa lham brdol dang stan brdol gnyis la/ sgom chen pa stan brdol dga' ba yin gsung*/ bla ma mi la dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ri la bzhugs te/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la ma 'das kyi bar du ri nas rir bzhud/ ri nas rir 'phos pa yin gsung*/ bde bar gshegs pa rin po che des bla ma mi la la zhus pa/ bla ma khyed 'di ltar rtag tu ri la bzhugs pa ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la dben par bsdad pa dang 'tshong dus su bsdad pa khyad med de/ da res kyi lus 'di la brten nas 'gro ba sems can thams cad snying phugs su bcug nas/ 'khor ba las da res e thon blta ba yin pas/ grong yul du sdod pa sgom chen pa'i spyod pa min (11na)gsung skad/ bde bar gshegs pa rin po ches kyang de kho na ltar mdzad pa yin/ rang re yang de'i rjes su sgrub/ de'i rjes su slob dgos pa yin/ thams cad kyis de bzhin du dgongs par zhu 'tshal/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag cig thun mong gi lam rnams rgyud la skyes nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug par 'dod pas/ theg pa chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la bsten pa gal che/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ brgyud pa dang brgyud par 'brel ba/ brgyud pa dang sgrar 'brel ba/ sgra dang sgra'i lung du 'brel ba/ lung dang byin rlabs su 'brel ba zhig dgos/

brgyud pa dang brgyud par 'brel ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ grub thob kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa/ dam nyams pa dang bslab 'chal gyi brgyud par ma song ba zhig dgos/ brgyud pa dang sgrar 'brel ba ni/ bka' brgyud rnams zhal nas zhal/ snyan nas snyan/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa ste/ yig nag dang dpe rul gyi brgyud par ma song ba zhig dgos/ sgra dang sgra'i lung du 'brel ba ni/ bla ma rnams kyis brjod bya'i don de nges par rtogs pa/ nges par thugs su chud pa zhig dgos/ lung dang byin rlabs su 'brel ba ni/ dgos dbang gis brgyud pa ma chad pa ste/ rang gis kyang gzhan gyi rgyud la yon tan skyed pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig dgos pas chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhig btsal/ yang na theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ gang zag chos kyi mig can dang*/ shes rab kyi mig can gnyis yin/ yang na (11ba)gsum yin te/ shes rab chen pos gzhan gyi lam sna 'khrid nus pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can yal bar mi 'dor ba/ tshe 'di'i mngon par zhen pa skra'i rtse mo brgyar bshags pa'i tshad tsam yang med pa zhig dgos/ yang na bzhi yin te/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa'i gdeng thob pa/ sems can la snying rje'i gdeng thob pa/ zab mo'i don la rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pa/ 'gro ba rnams la zang zing med pa'i chos ston pa'i bdag nyid can te/ chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhig bsten dgos/ rang re yang 'khor ba nas mya ngan las 'das par skyel na/ de lta bu'i bla ma zhig ma gtogs pa/ wa lta bu spre'u lta bu la bla ma mi bya gsung*/ rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i ltos thag bcad nas/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i sgom chen pa ste/ lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel ba/ sgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba/ 'bras bu gzhan don dang 'brel ba zhig dgos gsung*/

de la lta ba zer ba ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od gnyis yin/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku sems can gyi rgyud la yod pa de yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni/ rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang*/ yul dkar dmar du snang ba de yin/ de lta bu'i snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i 'od dang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos sku gnyis/ gnyis su med pa rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa/ rnam par byang ba/ smra bsam brjod las 'das pa gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa/ 'dus ma byas pa rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa ste/ dbyings dang ye (12na)shes dbyer med pa/ gzhi gnas lugs de lta bu cig yin te/ sangs rgyas rgan pos ma mdzad sems can sgrin pos ma bcos pa ste/ de'i 'dug tshul de la lta ba zer ba yin/ de yang rtogs dgos ma rtogs na phan pa med/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa med pa'i lta ba de// mtha' bral zer yang blos byas yin// zhes gsungs pas rtogs pa ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i 'od zer te/ gzung bar bya ba'i yul snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid bde ba chen por shar dgos/ de yang thos bsam gyi shes rab ma yin te/ bsgom byung gi bsod nams kyis de ltar nang nas 'char dgos/ de ltar rtogs na lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel ba yin no// sgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba ni/ de yang nyams su gang myong na rtogs pa'i don de nyams su myong*/ rtogs pa gang rtogs na nyams su myong ba'i don de rtogs pa yin/ nyams myong la nyams bye brag pa ni/ bsgom pa dang 'brel ba ma yin te/ bye brag pa ni rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel yin/ mig gi mthong snang dang*/ rna bas thos snang la sogs pa 'ong ba dang*/

bde gsal mi rtog pa zhi gnas kyi nyams su dus 'da' ba dang*/ mi snang ba dang*/ snang ba med pa/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar stong pa nyid la phyam 'gro ba snyam byed pa'i nyams byung yang*/ de nyams bye brag pa yin/ de ni re zhig yod kyang med par 'gro bas na/ lam 'bras nas bshad pas de ni nyams bye brag pa bya ba yin/ 'o na bsgom pa dang 'brel ba'i nyams de gang yin zhe na/ (12ba)ngo bo'i rang nyams zer/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang nyams zer gnyug ma'i rang nyams zer/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang nyams zer ba yin/ de gang la zer na rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la zer/ de ji lta bu yin zhe na/ yod pa yang ma yin pa ste ngos gzung rgyu skra'i rtse mo brgyar bshags pa tsam yang med/ med pa yang ma yin te nyams su myong rgyu dang*/ rtogs rgyu yod pa yin te/ de lta bu'i sems kyi ngo bo de/ gsal stong ngos bzung med pa/ gsal stong rgyun chad med par shar dgos/ de lta bur shar na bsgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba bya ba yin/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa dus gcig mchi zer ba yang de la zer ba yin no// spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba la bzhi yin/ las dang po bas rgyal po gzhon nu'i spyod pa bya/ sgrub pa pos gsang sngags kyi spyod pa bya/ grub pa pos rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya/ ye shes can gyis mnyam gzhag chen po yi spyod pa bya/ rgyal po gzhon nu'i spyod pa ni/ las dang po pas so sor thar pa dang*/ dge bsnyen la sogs pa ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin chag nyams med par bsrung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa smon 'jug gnyis ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin bsrung*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sde yod pa la/ bsdu na rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa ste dang po thos dgos/ shes par byas nas chags nyams med par gsung*/ tha ma chag nyams byung na/ nyams pa phyir bcos pa dang bshags sdom la 'bad par bya gsung*/

sgrub pa po gsang sngags kyi spyod pa ni/ gzhi bsgyur ba'i lam yin te/ dur khrod la sogs pa shin tu dben pa'i sar bsdad la mtshams bcad la bsgrub/ bsgrub ces pa ni lus lhar bsgrub/ ngag sngags su bsgrub/ sems chos nyid du bsgrub pa la zer ba yin te/ de yang ma hā mā (13na)yā las/ sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag dang*// 'di gsum rnal 'byor gsum yin te// rnal 'byor rnam pa 'di gsum gyis// srid pa'i skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas de la lus lhar bsgrub pa ni/ sgyu lus lha'i sku bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ ngag sngags su bsgrub pa ni/ rab ye shes kyi rlung tsan+ḍā li bsgom/ 'bring tha mal gyi rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum brtsi'o// tha ma yi dam lha'i snying po bgrang ba'o// sems chos nyid du bsgrub pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po gcig car du 'jug pa la sogs pa/ gsang sngags kyis thabs khyad par can la sogs pa nyams su blang*/ de yang gsang zhes pa ni lha gsang*/ bla ma gsang*/ chos gsang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gsang la sgrub// ces gsungs/ grub pa pos rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya ba ni/ grub pa pos gong ltar nyams su blangs la/ lus lhar grub/ ngag sngags su grub/ sems chos nyid du grub pa des/ bsad pa gso bar nus pa dang*// dgug dang mi snang sbed nus dang*// zhes pas/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya/ ye shes can gyis mnyam bzhag chen po'i spyod pa bya ba ni/ spyod lam rnam bzhir dus thams cad du mi slob pa'i zung 'jug mnyam bzhag rjes thob med par bde stong rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ngang la bde phril gyis song na/ spyod pa 'di bya 'di mi bya med de/ mdor na gza' gtad bral ba'i spyod pa yin/ de'ang gang zag gzhi ma lags pa/ gong mas 'og ma'i spyod pa mi bya/ 'og mas gong ma'i spyod pa mi bya/ rang tshod dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa ni/ dus tshod dang 'brel ba yin no// zhes so// 'bras (13ba)bu gzhan don dang 'brel ba ni/

de ltar gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dran 'dun dang rtogs dpyod btang mi dgos par mnyam bzhag chen po'i ngang la 'bad pa med par phril gyis song ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa lus rgya zhig pa'i dus su/ sku gsung thugs dbyer med bde ba chen po'i sku gnyis su med pa/ lhun gyis grub pa mngon du gyur pa ni 'bras bu thob pa'o// gzhan don dang 'brel ba ni/ de lta bu'i chos sku de las/ ngam ngam shugs kyis 'bad pa med par gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba ni sems can gyi don byed pa 'ong ba yin/ rang re rnams kyang lta spyod de rnams dang ldan pa bya dgos pa yin/ thams cad de bzhin du dgongs par zhu 'tshal gsung ngo*// rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang theg pa dman pa'i nyes dmigs/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran nas/ da res 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod na/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes dgos/ de yang tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya ba/ rang gi shes pa 'di la chos kyi rnam pa gang gis kyang ma bslad pa/ 'jig rten gyi rnam par shes pa gang gis kyang ma rnyogs pa/ bying rmugs dang rtog pa gang gis kyang ma gtum par rang sor gzhag pa yin/ de ngo shes na rang gi rig pa'i ye shes yin// ma rtogs na lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa yin/ rtogs na rig pa zhes bya/ ngo bo zhes bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes shes bya/ tha mal gyi shes pa shes bya/ gnyug ma zhes bya/ spros bral zhes bya/ 'od gsal zhes bya/ de rtogs na paṇ+ḍi ta rig (14na)pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa bas kyang yon tan che/ paṇ+ḍi ta ni don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed/ sgra mtshan nyid du byed pa yin/ kun shes gcig rdugs bya ba yin/ 'di rtogs na gcig shes kun la mkhas pa bya ba yin/ don dngos lam du byed pa yin pas yon tan che/

zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin ni nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa yod pa bas/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ ting nge 'dzin de ni thun mong ba yin te/ lha tshe ring dang*/ phyi ba dang dom la sogs pa khung du nyal ba rnams la'ang yod/ tha mal gyi shes pa'i thun mong ma yin pas yon tan che/ dbang bzhi rim gyis bskur nas bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pas/ reg pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ sgra'i mtshan ma la sogs pa yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba bas/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba ni/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob/ sgrib pa zad pa'i mtshan ma tsam yin/ tha mal gyi shes pa ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin pas/ yon tan che'o// mig dang rna ba la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga yod pa bas kyang*/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ mngon par shes pa ni zag pa dang bcas pa yin gyis/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro la yang yod/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes na/ ye shes ye shes khyad par che// ye shes ldan pa yod med shes// zhes gsungs pas/ zag pa med pa'i mngon par shes pa yin pas ngo mtshar che/ mi snang ba dang snang ba med pa/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar stong pa nyid du phyam phyam 'gro ba'i nyams yod kyang*/ de bas tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ de ni don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed pa/ rjes dpag lam du byed pa yin/ (14ba)tha mal gyi shes pa ni/ don dngos lam du byed pa yin/ mngon sum pa yin pas yon tan che'o// tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa ni shes rab kyi rgyal po yin/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi yul ma yin pas/ shes rab chen pos skad cig la// chos kun khong du chud pa 'chang*// chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste// zhes gsungs pas ye shes thams cad kyi rgyal po yin/ ye shes rnam pa lnga yang 'di la tshang ba yin te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du rtogs pas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes yin/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// skad cig sems kyi don kun rig

/ces gsungs pas/ lam lnga la sogs pa bgrod mi dgos par/ skad cig gcig gis don thams cad grub pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyang 'di yin/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad kyang me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rtogs pas me long lta bu'i ye shes kyang 'di yin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad rang gi rig par mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyang 'di yin/ de'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med// dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa// ye shes mig gcig dri ma med// ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ye shes thams cad kyi rgyal po yin no// yon tan thams cad kyi rgyal po yin te/ mngon par shes pa gong ma rnams las che ba med/ de bas tha mal gyi shes pa yon tan che/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po yin te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag ji tsam zhig yod kyang*/ 'di rtogs na thams cad phyi shun dang sbun par 'gro ba yin/ (15na)chos thams cad kyi snying po 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di ngo shes ma shes yin pas/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa gal che gsung ngo*/// /rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ lta ba 'dod pa gnyis dang bral ba/ sgom pa go rim gsum dang bral ba/ spyod pa snga phyi gnyis dang bral ba/ 'bras bu re dwogs gnyis dang bral ba zhig dgos gsung*/ de la lta ba 'dod pa gnyis dang bral ba ni/ gzhi gnas lugs kyi 'dug tshul/ rtogs nas rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' gnyis dang mthun na dga' ba dang*/ ma mthun gyis dogs pa'i grub mtha'i 'dod pa dang*/ da lta'i 'dod pa'i gnas lugs de nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu 'di dang 'di 'byung snyam pa'i 'dod pa dang bral ba zhig dgos/ sgom pa go rim gsum dang bral ba ni/ sbyor ba la 'di ltar bsgom/ dngos gzhi la 'di ltar bsgom/ rjes la 'di ltar bsgom bya ba'i go rim dang bral bas dus rtag tu chos nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos par/

chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bsgom dgos pa yin gsung*/ spyod pa snga phyi gnyis dang bral ba ni/ sngon la 'di bya rjes la 'di bya snyam pa dang bral ba ste/ mdor na gza' gtad dang bral ba zhig dgos gsung*/ yang na spyod pa dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral ba ni/ nyon mongs pa spang bar 'dod pa dang*/ gnyen po ye shes sgrub par 'dod pa dang bral ba ste/ mdor na dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral ba zhig dgos gsung ngo*// 'bras bu re dwogs gnyis dang bral ba ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob par re ba dang*/ 'khor bar 'khyams kyis dogs pa dang bral ba zhig dgos te/ mdor (15ba)na 'khor 'das gnyis med bde ba chen por rtogs pa la/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med/ mar 'khor ba la dogs pa med pa zhig dgos/ rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa/ don de lta bu zhig dang ldan pa dgos pa yin pas/ de ltar dgongs 'tshal gsung*/ rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir chos nyan pa la/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa gnyis yin/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa la bzhi/ bdag grags pa 'dod pa'i phyir ma yin gyis/ gzhan 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir nyan bsam pa dang*/ bdag rnyed pa dang*/ bkur sti thob par bya ba'i phyir ma yin te/ gzhan du na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir nyan snyam pa dang*/ bdag rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i phyir ma yin gyi/ gzhan du na nyon mongs pa'i dgra g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir nyan snyam pa dang*/ bdag chos kyi mkhan po'i mtshang 'bru ba'i phyir ma yin gyis/ gzhan du na chos kyi mkhan po dang*/ chos la gus par bya ba'i phyir nyan snyam pa'o// sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba la/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bus byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs/ dngos gzhi la chos gang yin yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi don tshang ba'i sgo nas nyan/

rjes la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba yin/ de thams cad kyi don bsdus nas nyams su len pa ni/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bdag rdzogs (16na)pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gdams ngag rin po che nyan par bya/ go bar bya/ rtogs par bya/ nyams su blang bar bya snyam pa'i bsam pa khyad par can bskyed dgos pa yin/ lar chos nyan pa la bsam pa rnam par dag pa gal che gsung*/// /rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ gol sa thams cad kyi che ba gang*/ 'jig rten 'di'i mngon zhen yin/ de bas tshe 'di la blo ldog dgos/ tshe 'di la blo ma log pa la sgom chen pa 'ong ba'i thabs med gsung*/ nyams su len pa la nyams myong gi gol sa gsum/ lta ba'i shor sa bzhi yod/ nyams myong gi gol sa gsum ni/ lus bde/ sems bde/ lus bde bas rgyas pa'i nyams 'byung ste/ de la chags shing mngon par zhen nas mchog tu bzung bas/ 'dod khams nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin te/ de'i skabs su shi na 'dod pa'i khams su gol nas 'gro ste/ 'dod pa khams kyi bde ba'i longs spyod myong nas/ mar ngan song gsum du mu mtha' med pa la 'gro ba la tshegs med/ bying rmugs dang bral ba la gsal ba'i nyams byung ba la chags shing mchog tu bzung bas gzugs khams su gol nas 'gro ba yin gsung*/ de'i bde ba dang longs spyod myong nas mar la ltung ba la tshegs med/ rnam rtog rlung gis ma bskyod pa'i nyams byung ba la/ chags zhen mchog tu bzung bas/ gzugs med kyi khams nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin te/ de'i skabs su shi na gzugs med khams su gol nas 'gro ba'i rgyu yin gsung*/ de'i bde ba dang longs spyod myong nas/ ngan song gsum du mu mtha' med par 'gro ba yin/ de gsum du ma gol yang*/ stong pa nyid la (16ba)shor sa bzhi yod de/

stong pa nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad ye dag ye grol te/ dang po ye nas sangs rgyas ye nas lhun grub yin pas/ bsgoms pas bzang dum song*/ ma bsgoms pas ngan du ma song*/ dge mi dge med/ dge bas phan mi 'dogs/ mi dge bas gnod mi skyel ba ni/ ra rog po'i khong par lag pa bcug pa dang*/ phad rtse nag po'i nang du lag pa bcug pa 'dra zer nas/ stong pa kha 'byam du smra ba de ni stong pa nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba yin gsung*/ stong pa nyid gnyen por shor ba ni lar gzhung kā ri ka yan chad/ gsang ba 'dus pa man chad kyi thos bsam byed pa dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa yan chad/ skye ba med pa'i don bsgom pa man chad kyi srung sdom/ bsags sbyangs/ sgom sgrub ci byed pa nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro dgos/ de bas nyon mongs pa'i gzhi rtsa chod pa gal che/ gzhi rtsa chod na thangs shing gi rtsa ba chod pa dang 'dra ba yin/ de ltar ma gyur na nyon mongs pa dug lnga/ dug gsum gang skyes kyang stong pa nyid yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin ma grub par blos dpyad nas bzhag pas/ ma grub par bsgoms pa des phan pa 'dra ste/ des nyon mongs pa rtsad nas chod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ mgo yang ma non kha yang ma bri ste/ gzhi rtsa ma chod pa'i blos dpyad nas gzhag pa stong pa nyid nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por shor ba bya ba yin gsung*/ stong pa nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ dkar po'i chos ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pa'i gnyen por gcig dang du bral la sogs pas gzhigs pa'i rig pa'i gzhal gzhig byas pas (17na)ma grub par gtan la phab kyang rung*/ shūn+ya tā'am/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs nas ma grub par byas kyang rung*/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin par byas pas rang bzhin ma grub par byas kyang rung ste/

dang po dngos po dang mtshan ma can dmigs/ rjes la rang bzhin ma grub pa stong par rgyas 'debs pa ni/ stong pa nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba yin gsung*/ stong pa nyid lam du shor ba ni/ lar phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i dus su/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum rang bzhin gcig gis rdzogs pa yin/ blos byas ma yin par nang nas 'char ba yin pas na/ mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med// dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa// ye shes mig gcig dri ma med// ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu la gsungs pa yin pa la/ de ma shes par stong pa nyid bsgom pa la lam byas nas/ 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa zhig thob par bya snyam pa ni stong pa nyid lam du shor ba yin/ lar de ltar ma song ba gal che gsung*/// /rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ lar theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis/ srung sdom dang*/ bsags sbyang dang*/ sbyin gtong gi rim pa ci byed kyang*/ dngos po gtso mi che/ bsam pa gtso che ba yin pas/ chos spyod ci byed kyang sngon la bsam pa rnam par dag pa gal che/ de yang bsam pa khyad par can bskyed la/ byang chub kyi sems rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yin gsung*/ rgyas pa ni rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu/ nam (17ba)mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya dgos/ theg pa chung ngu'i nyan thos kyi byang chub dang*/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub ma yin te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya dgos/ de'i phyir na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i thabs su chos spyod sgom sgrub kyi rim pa 'di dang 'di bya snyam du sems bskyed gsung*/ 'bring ni rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir 'di dang 'di bya snyam pa'o// bsdus pa ni rmi lam sgyu ma lta bus sems can thams cad kyi don du chos spyod kyi rim pa 'di bya snyam du blo bskyed/

lar bsags sbyang gi rim pa gang dang gang byed kyang*/ sbyor ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bus byang chub kyi sems rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig gis kun nas bslangs nas/ dngos gzhi rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur chos thams cad nyams su blang*/ rjes rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can gyi don du bsngo'o/// /de nas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bus bsngo ba po bdag dang*/ bsngo ba'i yul sems can dang*/ bsngo ba'i dngos po de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rang gi sems nyid dang tha mi dad cing*/ gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo sems nyid kyi cho 'phrul du shes par bya gsung*/ rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed 'dir tshogs pa'i sgom chen pa rnams sgrub pa rnal mar byed na/ tshe 'di'i sdos thag gcad nas lus srog 'ben du btsugs/ lto gos la gyong bskur nas nyams su len dgos pa yin/ de ltar byed pa la ri khrod bsten dgos pa yin gsung*/ rab seng ge bzhin du gangs la song*// 'bring rgya stag bzhin du nags (18na)la song*// tha ma bya rgod bzhin du brag la song*// dur khrod kyi wa mo ltar grong du gzhol bar ma byed/ lar zas gos gnyis la 'khri ba che ba la ri pa mi 'ong bas/ gos ras gos rkyang pa thub pa gal che/ zas gyi na tsam la brten nas/ che rung chung rung don cig sgrub na/ tshe 'di la skyid kyang bzod/ sdug kyang bzod/ ci byung 'dra snyam pa zhig dgos/ lar chos byed na mi thams cad la re ma che/ mgu dka' la 'khang ma skyen/ drin ma rtsi dang yags par 'ong*/ kho bos ni su la yang drin rtsi ma myong ste/ kho bo ni khyed cag rnams la drin che snyam/ lar slob mas slob dpon gyi zhabs 'dren pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i zhabs 'dren pa mnyam po yin pa la/ kho bos khyed tsho'i zhabs 'dren du ma song bar bya snyam pa yin/ kho bo'i slob mar gyur pa thams cad rab skye ba 'di la bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod pa yin/

'bring bar do la/ tha ma skye ba phyi ma la rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa yin/ khyed tsho rang mgo rang gis ma rdung*/ rang gis rang la thugs la thogs dang*/ nges par de kho na ltar yin la/ spyir chos byed pa la kha chos par ma song ba/ zhar chos par ma song ba/ sla chos par ma song ba/ lo chos par ma song bar gyis/ mis kyang chos byed mkhan yin snyam/ rang gis kyang chos byas snyam nas/ mi nag tu 'chi nyen yod pa yin pas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras bsgom pa gal che/ 'di brtson 'grus kyi lcag yin/ lar chos la zhugs pa'i gang zag ni/ rab 'chi khar dga' yal le/ 'dzum mu le/ brod ting nge ba/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba zhig dgos/ 'bring 'chi khar mi 'tsher ba zhig (18ba)dgos/ tha ma lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas ngas 'di dang 'di byas snyam 'gyod pa med pa zhig dgos/ sgom chen pa rnams ri khrod bsten pa'i dgos pa ni/ bya byed thams cad spangs/ g.yeng ba thams cad spangs la/ dben par rtse gcig tu dge sbyor nyams su len par 'dod nas ri khrod bsten pa yin/ g.yeng ba byed na grong gseb dang*/ sde pa'i nang du byed pas chog pas/ ri la bsdad nas grong gseb las g.yeng ba che ba ma byed/ dge sbyor la brtson par gyis/ dge sbyor mi zad pa'i gter chen po yin pas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin/ skye ba gtan gyi bsod nams yin pas shin tu gal che/ dge sbyor skyes nas goms par mthar phyin dgos/ sgom lta thog tu skyel dgos pa yin/ de lta bu zhig gis gzhan don byed pa yin pas/ de min pas gzhan don byas pas rang la ni gnod/ gzhan la phan par ni dka' bas/ sngon la rang don mthar phyin par mdzod la/ de nas slob ma skyongs/ rang don mthar phyin pa la ri khrod 'grim pa gal che/ de la bka' gdams pa'i zhal nas/ ri khrod 'grim pa la chos lnga yin gsung*/

tshul khrims la ngos lkog med pa/ gnyen pos rkyen thub pa/ gdams ngag la rang byan tshud pa/ dad pas khams sos pa/ nus pas gnod pa phra mo sel nus pa zhig dgos gsung*/ bde bar gshegs pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ ri khrod bsten pa la chos bzhi yin gsung*/ gdams ngag gi gdeng thob pa/ nus pa'i gdeng thob pa/ nyams myong gi gdeng thob pa/ lta ba'i gdeng thob pa zhig dgos te/ don de rnams dang ldan par byed pa la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes nye bar 'jog (19na)pa/ gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs shing*/ bla ma'i spyan sngar yun ring dgos/ bya mos lud pa thob pa bzhin song bas mi chog /de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la go 'dris su ma song ba/ gdams ngag la sna dred du ma song ba/ dad pa snod rnying du ma song ba gal che/ mi lus rin po che thob/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ chos rin po che thob/ yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che dang mjal/ gdams ngag rin po che zhus/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rang dbang yod pa'i rten 'brel 'di rnams 'dzom steng la bsgom dgos/ de'i dus su bsgom na sgom mi yong mi srid/ ma byung na rang gis ma bsgoms pa yin/ bla ma mnyes par byed pa la/ rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog yin/ 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog yin/ tha ma zang zing gi zhabs tog yin pas/ chos gsha' mar byas na rang don gzhan don kun 'byung*/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dus thams cad du skyid pa rang skyid/ smon pa mis smon pa 'ong ba yin/ de ltar ma byas na sdug pa rang sdug /'phya ba mis 'phya/ 'bras bu ngan song du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ khyed rnams snying thag pa nas chos bya snyam na/ brtson 'grus dang gnyen po dang dad gus kyi stobs bskyed la/ bla ma dang mched grogs kyi zhabs 'dren du ma song ba/ sems can gyi sdig rkyen du ma song ba ste/ mdor na las mtha' ma log pa re mdzad par zhu gsung*/// /rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyis slob mas bla mar bsten pa la/

chos bcu yin gsung*/ de yang skyo dub med pa'i dad pa can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par (19ba)bya ste/ grub pa'i dpe lta bu zhig dgos/ ser sna med pa'i zang zing can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya ste/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang*// rang gi srog kyang gtang bar bya// zhes pa dang mthun pa zhig dgos/ dri ma med pa'i lhag bsam can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes gsungs pas/ dri ma ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su sems bskyed pa man chad kyi bsam pa gang gis kyang kun nas bslangs pa ma yin par/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dgos/ rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ bla ma'i gdams ngag rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa gang la yang ma rmongs pa zhig dgos gsungs pas/ nga rgyal med pa'i gus pa can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ bla ma la sman pa'i 'du shes/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ nad pas sman pa bkur ba lta bu zhig dgos/ som nyi med pa'i sri zhu can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ bla mas ci gsungs pa la the tshom med par yid ches pa zhig dgos/ g.yo sgyu med pa'i drang mkhan can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ rdzun dang g.yo sgyu spangs nas snyig thag pa nas gus pa zhig dgos/ gyong khengs med pa'i mnyen lcug can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ rang rgyud gyong po dang rigs rus kyi khengs pa dang rlom pa med pa'i phyir zhi dul dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' byung na yi ge na'i 'jug ma chod/ ces pa ni/ bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin byed pa zhig dgos/ khro ba med pa'i (20na)bzod pa can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ bla ma nā ro pas dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad pa lta bu zhig dgos/

tha mal ma yin pa'i lha sku can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ zhes pa ni/ bla ma la dus thams cad du tha mal gyi 'du shes med par sangs rgyas su blta ba zhig dgos gsung*/ bla ma bsten pa la chos de tsho dang ldan pa zhig gal che/ ci rung rung byas pas mi yong ba yin gsung*/ rje rin po che'i gsung sgros/ dge slong shes rab gzhon nus yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// dge'o//
